description: Check available time slots for booking a meeting. Returns a list of available date/time windows for the specified event type. Use this before creating a booking to find suitable times. Always check availability first to avoid booking conflicts.

duration.description: Duration in minutes for variable-duration event types. If the event type supports multiple durations (e.g., 15/30/60 min), specify which duration to check availability for.

end_date.description: End of the date range to check (ISO 8601 date, e.g., '2026-03-22')

event_type_id.description: ID of the event type to check availability for. Optional if ASTROCAL_DEFAULT_EVENT_TYPE_ID is set.

start_date.description: Start of the date range to check (ISO 8601 date, e.g., '2026-03-15')

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the availability results (e.g., 'America/New_York'). Defaults to UTC.

name: check_availability
